This reply reaches the member-of-household relative (dependent.qr_all_year with dependent.lawful), which earlier replies did not; what remains is where it puts its screens. The reply reads dependent.multiple_support and dependent.kidnapped for every entry (and dependent.lawful for every entry that is not a listed relative), so on completed returns it needs an answer the interview does not ask of that person or refuses a person the project claims (t091.kidnapped.age19 parent, f1.kidnapped.returned_11 child, generated 126 and 369 dep_b): model error, as ruled before; the project asks the multiple-support and kidnapping questions only where its qualifying-relative or residency test reads them. The value differences are on refused returns where the filer can be claimed as a dependent (sa.dependent yes) on a joint return: the reply follows Step 4, question 4 (i1040gi p. 19, "Are you filing a joint return for 2025?
